name: note_taking
description: 노트 작성 앱 예시. FR 5 + NFR 2. 선택 실행(멀티 데이터셋) 시연용 두 번째 세트.

classified.text: A user can create a new note with a title and body.
A user can edit the content of an existing note.
A user can delete a note.
A user can search notes by keyword.
A user can share a note with another user by email.
Note edits shall be auto-saved within 1 second.
Note content shall be encrypted end-to-end.
